verdict.rationale: Datadog is an observability platform that could plausibly ship background automations, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no user-configurable autonomous or background automation feature such as workflows or scheduled jobs. The material shown covers API access, LLM-observability SDKs, managed evaluations and coverage-based merge blocking, which are adjacent features rather than the automation capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
